verdict.rationale: Adyen is API-first, so it runs headlessly by design. Server-side Checkout API calls drive payments, a separate test environment with test credentials supports automated testing, and idempotency keys allow safe retries. Scoped API credentials and webhooks support unattended operation, and the MCP server runs non-interactively via `npx` with the API key supplied through an environment variable. missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline integration guidance, an official non-MCP CLI for scripted automation, independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use
